- The Council shall advise the President and Congress if and
when the exercise of emergency presidential powers shall be required to address
food and energy problems.

- The Council on Climate Change, which will discuss similar
issues and whose priority will need to be reconciled with food and energy, is
hereby absorbed by the NFEC.

- All other rules, regulations and issuances or parts thereof
which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

- This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
2nd day of June
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
